# Configuration

jogpad reads a TOML file, by default none (all values below apply). Pass it with `jogpad serve --config jogpad.toml`.

## `[machine]`

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | `"moonraker"` | Firmware interface. Only Moonraker (Klipper) for now. |
| `url` | `"http://127.0.0.1:7125"` | Base URL of the firmware's HTTP interface. |
| `locks` | `[{"object": "print_stats", "field": "state", "equals": ["printing", "paused"], "reason": "job running"}]` | Conditions under which jogpad refuses to move or home. STOP always works. If the status cannot be read, or a lock's object or field does not exist, jogpad refuses as well. |

## `[jog]`

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `[0.01, 0.1, 1.0]` | Step sizes in mm. The step key cycles through them; jogpad starts with the first. |
| `hold_delay` | `0.5` | Seconds an axis key must be held before its axis keeps moving until the key is released. A shorter press moves one step. |
| `hold_speeds_xy` | `[2.0, 10.0, 50.0]` | Speeds in mm/s for X and Y while a key is held, one per step size; the step key switches both. At most 250. Klipper cannot take back a move it has queued, so the axis runs on for up to 0.65 s after the key is released: up to 33 mm at 50 mm/s. |
| `hold_speeds_z` | `[0.5, 2.0, 10.0]` | Speeds in mm/s for Z while a key is held, one per step size. Klipper keeps them below its `max_z_velocity`. |
| `hold_speeds_e` | `[1.0, 2.0, 5.0]` | Speeds in mm/s for the extruder while a key is held, one per step size. |
| `feed_xy` | `3000.0` | Feed rate for X and Y in mm/min. |
| `feed_z` | `600.0` | Feed rate for Z in mm/min. |
| `feed_e` | `300.0` | Feed rate for the extruder in mm/min. |
| `select_axes` | `["X", "Y"]` | Axes that `select_next` cycles through for a knob. |
| `home_timeout` | `5.0` | Seconds after which an unfinished HOME selection is dropped. |
| `announce_moves` | `true` | Report every move and homing in the firmware console, so others can see who moved the machine. |
| `invert` | `[]` | Axes whose keys move the other way, e.g. when the bed moves instead of the tool. Klipper's coordinates stay as they are. |

## `[input]`

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `devices` | `[]` | Input devices to read, e.g. `/dev/input/by-id/usb-...-event-kbd`. jogpad grabs them exclusively. |
| `keys` | `see below` | Key names or numbers per action, as in `linux/input-event-codes.h`. Merged over the defaults of the layout: for `ch57x-9k3` those of a pad programmed with `jogpad program-pad`, otherwise the numeric keypad's. `[]` switches an action off. |
| `layout` | `"numpad"` | Pad drawn on the web page: `numpad`, `ch57x-9k3`, or `none` to list pressed keys only. |
| `step_light` | `true` | With a CH57x layout such as `ch57x-9k3`, light the pad in the colour of the step size: green for the smallest, so green after a start, red for the largest, yellow between. The pad stores every new colour in its flash memory, which takes only so many writes; `false` leaves its light alone. |

## `[server]`

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `"0.0.0.0"` | Address the web interface and API listen on. `0.0.0.0` lets every computer in the network watch; `127.0.0.1` keeps the page on the machine itself. |
| `port` | `7150` | Port of the web interface and API. |
| `language` | `"en"` | Language of console messages, and of the web page for viewers whose browser asks for none of the available ones. |
| `allow_remote_changes` | `false` | Let every computer change the configuration through the web page. Without it only the machine itself and the computers Moonraker trusts (`trusted_clients`) may. |

## Default keys

They depend on `layout`; every layout not listed here, `none` included, gets those of `numpad`.

| Action | `numpad` | `ch57x-9k3` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x_plus` | `KEY_KP6` | `KEY_F18`, `KEY_KATAKANAHIRAGANA` |
| `x_minus` | `KEY_KP4` | `KEY_F16`, `KEY_RO` |
| `y_plus` | `KEY_KP8` | `KEY_F14`, `KEY_HENKAN` |
| `y_minus` | `KEY_KP2` | `KEY_F20`, `KEY_YEN` |
| `z_plus` | `KEY_KPPLUS` | `KEY_KPJPCOMMA` |
| `z_minus` | `KEY_KPMINUS` | `KEY_MUHENKAN` |
| `e_plus` | – | `KEY_F21` |
| `e_minus` | – | `KEY_F19` |
| `selected_plus` | – | – |
| `selected_minus` | – | – |
| `select_next` | – | – |
| `step` | `KEY_KPASTERISK` | `KEY_F17` |
| `home` | `KEY_KPENTER` | `KEY_F13` |
| `stop` | `KEY_KP0` | `KEY_F15` |
